The S&P 500 faces mounting bearish pressures from the Iran war and a coordinated hawkish shift by global central banks.
 Technical signals suggest a potential short-term bounce from the 6500 support area, but upside is likely capped near 6764–6775.
 Persistent inflation and diminished prospects for Fed rate cuts limit the medium-term upside, while distribution patterns and a rounded top signal technical caution.
